brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
A mass prison break was reported at Kakata Central Prison, with inmates fleeing into nearby communities. [2]
More than 100 inmates reportedly escaped Kakata Central Prison, as confirmed by the Justice Ministry. [3]
Security forces are hunting the Kakata Prison escapees. [4]
Liberia launched the PATHWAYs Framework and called for a global partnership on youth, peace, security, and development. [5]

KEY RISKS
The ongoing hunt for the Kakata Prison escapees may involve risks to security forces and the public. [4]

WATCH ITEMS
The search for the Kakata Prison escapees continues, with security forces actively hunting them. [4]
